changes.to: Android keyboard: the candidate bar shows only the candidates that fit the screen; the rest are in the expanded list, which wraps to the screen width

**Outcome.** No candidate is cut off at the screen edge: the bar holds what fits, ⌄ shows the others in lines as wide as the screen.

**Done means.** On the emulator, typing ki shows whole candidates only in the bar; ⌄ lists the rest, wrapped, none cut off; choosing any of them types it.

**Notes.** Asked by the person on 2026-10-24.
